summary.text: Cody Mitchell is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 65, who assumed office on November 14, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a trial lawyer, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Mitchell was born in Greeneville, Tennessee, and lives in Bethune, South Carolina, according to Ballotpedia.

He earned a B.A. in history from Presbyterian College in 2008 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 2011, and his career experience includes working as a trial lawyer with Lucas, White, & Mitchell.
Mitchell has served on the board of the Sandhills Medical Foundation.
Mitchell assumed office on November 14, 2022, and Ballotpedia lists him on the House Judiciary Committee and the House Rules Committee for the 2025-2026 session.
